notes: multibuy_header (changed after the first audit run): the original wording also failed when 'more than one' card was displayed, and the model counted the matching shelf-edge label below the packs as a second card. Reworded to identify the header card by position.
After GPT-6.2 Sol data review: removed no_single_pack_label: under the Price Marking Order 2004 the single-pack price must still be shown, so the brief no longer bans it.

checks.requirement: Hollin Classic is on the top shelf and is not split across shelves.
checks.question: Check which shelves hold Hollin Classic.
checks.compliant: Hollin Classic is on the top shelf only.
checks.not_compliant: Hollin Classic is missing from the top shelf or also appears on another shelf.

checks.requirement: At least four Hollin Classic red packs face forward side by side.
checks.question: Count the side-by-side, forward-facing Hollin Classic red packs.
checks.compliant: At least four Hollin Classic packs face forward in one continuous run.
checks.not_compliant: Fewer than four face forward, or their facings are separated.

checks.requirement: The Hollin Classic display has no visibly empty facings.
checks.question: Look for empty spaces within the Hollin Classic run.
checks.compliant: The Hollin Classic run has no visibly empty facing or gap.
checks.not_compliant: An empty facing or gap is visible within the Hollin Classic run.

checks.rule: Brief: Range and placement; Store responsibilities
checks.requirement: Other brands and products outside this campaign do not interrupt the Hollin Classic display.
checks.question: Check whether any other product occupies or interrupts the Hollin Classic block.
checks.compliant: The Hollin Classic block contains only Hollin Classic; other products are outside it.
checks.not_compliant: Another brand or a different product occupies or interrupts the Hollin Classic block.

checks.requirement: A yellow promotional shelf-edge label reading “2 for £7” is directly below the Hollin Classic facings.
checks.question: Check the colour, wording and position of the shelf-edge label below Hollin Classic.
checks.compliant: A yellow label reading “2 for £7” is directly below the Hollin Classic facings.
checks.not_compliant: The label is absent, is not yellow, has different offer wording, or is not directly below those facings.

checks.requirement: One “2 for £7” header card is displayed above the Hollin Classic facings.
checks.question: Check the header card clipped ABOVE the Hollin Classic packs. This is separate from the shelf-edge label below the packs, which is a different item and is not part of this check.
checks.compliant: A header card reading "2 for £7" is displayed above the Hollin Classic packs.
checks.not_compliant: There is no header card above the Hollin Classic packs, or the card above them shows different wording.

checks.requirement: Earlier or unrelated Hollin promotional material is absent from the Hollin Classic display.
checks.question: Look for Hollin promotional labels or cards at the Classic display that advertise an offer other than “2 for £7”.
checks.compliant: The Hollin Classic display shows no earlier or unrelated Hollin offer material.
checks.not_compliant: An earlier or unrelated Hollin offer label or card remains at the Hollin Classic display.

not_checkable.rule: Brief: Campaign period; Display set-up deadline
not_checkable.requirement: The display was set up by 31 May 2027 and maintained during 1–30 June 2027.
Hollin Classic stays stocked over time, including on Saturdays.
Store teams do not move Hollin products to make room for other brands’ promotions.
Week-two audit photographs are submitted and the £30 display incentive is awarded.
Hollin Classic is easy to find and the multibuy is impossible to miss.
